verdict.rationale: Slack's Web API and MCP server require scoped bot/user tokens rather than open access (slack-probe-5, slack-probe-6), and the MCP endpoint is auth-gated, implying a credentialing system exists, but the evidence pack never documents how an AI-native user actually creates/scopes an OAuth token to least-privilege permissions for an agent specifically, nor any per-agent scope management UI or docs. Missing for 10: explicit docs on OAuth scope selection/granularity for agent tokens, guidance on least-privilege token issuance workflow, and independent confirmation that scopes can be finely restricted for an AI agent use case.
